plan: A fighter who is very weak early but becomes one of the strongest in the game in the late game.
aSurveiller: Her R (Divine Judgment). She makes an ally invulnerable for a few seconds: don't waste your spells on the protected target.
contrer: Attack her early: she is very weak before level 6.
Try to end the game quickly: in the late game she becomes fearsome.
Wait for her R to end before hitting the protected target.
forces: Huge power in the late game.
Her R makes an ally invulnerable.
Ranged attacks that hit an area later on.
faiblesses: Very weak in the early game.

sorts.P: Grows stronger every level: range, speed and area damage.
sorts.Q: Sword that pierces, slows and shreds resistances.
sorts.W: Heals herself and an ally, with a speed boost.
sorts.E: Her attacks deal more magic damage.
sorts.R: Makes an ally invulnerable and rains swords around them.

momentFort: Weak early, stronger and stronger: she becomes fearsome at level 11 and then at level 16.
